dct_description_sm: This study investigated the sinking export of organic material, using short-term particle interceptor traps, during the fall of 2007. Assessing the export of organic material from the euphotic zone is essential for our understanding of pelagic-benthic coupling processes, and the transfer of carbon to the pelagic ecosystem or to marine sediments. Knowledge of these carbon pathways is essential for understanding the carbon budget of the Arctic Ocean under changing environmental conditions.
dct_title_s: Sinking export of organic material in the High Arctic in fall 2007
